verdict.rationale: Circle documents Agent Wallets that let an AI agent hold and spend USDC autonomously within spending policies the developer defines, and Agent Nanopayments let the agent itself pay x402 services in USDC. That covers agent-initiated payments under human-configured spend controls. Missing for 10: detailed docs on which spending-policy controls exist (limits, allowlists, approvals), a documented end-to-end agent payout flow (e.g. via CPN), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can move stablecoins under scoped authority — documented agent payment flows where an agent initiates a payment or payout with spend controls a human configured

citations.quote: Agent Wallets let your AI agent hold funds and transact onchain autonomously, within spending policies you define.
Use Agent wallets to hold and spend USDC and other tokens with customizable spending controls and built-in compliance guardrails.
Agent Nanopayments, built on Gateway Nanopayments, let your AI agent pay for x402-compatible services in sub-cent USDC.
